'''Josephine Wairimu Kagunda''' is a Kenyan [[Mathematician|applied mathematician]] and [[Epidemiology|epidemiologist]]. She works on developing deterministic models of [[infectious diseases]] to support the planning of effective public health interventions. She is a member, president and the chair of the [[African Women in Mathematics Association]] (AWMA) and a prominent member of the Kenya Women in Mathematical Sciences Association (KWIMSA). She is a reviewer for the international peer-reviewed journal the ''Universal Journal of Applied Mathematics''.

== Biography ==
Kagunda grew up in a Kenyan village. Her father fundraised to enable her to study at university.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Josephine Wairimu KAGUNDA |url=https://africanwomeninmath.org/women-in-math/portrait/josephine-wairimu-kagunda |access-date=2025-07-15 |website=[[African Women in Mathematics Association]] (AWMA)}}</ref>

Kagunda studied her bachelor's degree at the [[University of Nairobi]]. She was awarded a PhD in [[Biomathematics]] from the [[University of Lorraine]], France.<ref>{{Cite thesis |last=Wairimu |first=Josephine Kagunda |title=Mathematical analysis and dynamical systems : modeling Highland malaria in western Kenya |date=2012-11-23 |degree=phdthesis |publisher=Université de Lorraine |url=https://theses.hal.science/tel-01749395 |language=en}}</ref> In 2015 she was awarded an [[International Mathematical Union]] (IMU) scholarship to complete a period of research at the [[California State University, Northridge|California State University]], [[Northridge, Los Angeles|Northridge]], Los Angeles, United States of America.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2015 Awarded IMU-Simons Travel Fellowship Recipients |url=https://www.mathunion.org/cdc/2015-awarded-imu-simons-travel-fellowship-recipients |access-date=2025-07-15 |website=[[International Mathematical Union]]}}</ref>

Kagunda teaches as a senior lecturer at the School of Mathematics, University of Nairobi<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=DR. JOSEPHINE WAIRIMU KAGUNDA {{!}} DEPARTMENT OF MATHEMATICS |url=https://mathematics.uonbi.ac.ke/staff/dr-josephine-wairimu-kagunda |access-date=2025-07-15 |website=mathematics.uonbi.ac.ke |archive-date=21 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250621141500/http://mathematics.uonbi.ac.ke/staff/dr-josephine-wairimu-kagunda |url-status=live }}</ref> and works with the Ohio State Health and Environment Modelling team (HEALMOD) at the College of Public Health, [[Ohio State University]], [[Columbus, Ohio|Columbus]], United States of America.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Josephine Wairimu Kagunda |url=https://cph.osu.edu/people/kagunda2 |access-date=2025-07-15 |website=College of Public Health |language=en}}</ref> She works on developing deterministic [[Epidemiology|epidemiological]] models of infectious diseases to support the planning of effective public health interventions. She has published research on diseases including [[Kidney failure|renal failure]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kagunda |first=Josephine Wairimu |date=2018-04-07 |title=The role of social learning and wealth in the dynamics of renal failure in Kenya |url=https://biomath.math.bas.bg/biomath/index.php/bmcs/article/view/1202 |journal=Biomath Communications Supplement |language=en |archive-date=6 December 2023 |access-date=15 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231206090203/https://biomath.math.bas.bg/biomath/index.php/bmcs/article/view/1202 |url-status=live }}</ref> [[HIV/AIDS]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Ronoh |first=Marilyn |last2=Chirove |first2=Faraimunashe |last3=Wairimu |first3=Josephine |last4=Ogana |first4=Wandera |date=2020-11-17 |title=Evidence-based modeling of combination control on Kenyan youth HIV/AIDS dynamics |url=https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0242491 |journal=PLOS ONE |language=en |volume=15 |issue=11 |pages=e0242491 |issn=1932-6203 |pmc=7671564 |archive-date=3 March 2025 |access-date=15 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250303074525/https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0242491 |url-status=live }}</ref> [[malaria]]<ref name="auto">{{Cite journal |last=Wairimu |first=Josephine |last2=Chirove |first2=Faraimunashe |last3=Ronoh |first3=Marilyn |last4=Malonza |first4=David M. |date=2018-12-01 |title=Modeling the effects of insecticides resistance on malaria vector control in endemic regions of Kenya |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0303264717300400 |journal=Biosystems |volume=174 |pages=49–59 |doi=10.1016/j.biosystems.2018.09.002 |issn=0303-2647|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and [[tuberculosis]], as well as [[insecticide]] resistance.<ref name="auto"/> Her work has been cited in further studies on the impact of temperature in malaria disease transmission dynamics<ref>Bhuju, G., G. R. Phaijoo, and D. B. Gurung. [https://www.researchgate.net/publication/326066200_Mathematical_Study_on_Impact_of_Temperature_in_Malaria_Disease_Transmission_Dynamics "Mathematical study on impact of temperature in malaria disease transmission dynamics."] ''Advances in Computer Sciences'' 1.2 (2018): 1-8, retrieved 23 July 2025.</ref> and modelling HIV/AIDS dynamics in Kenya.<ref>Ronoh, Maryln C., (2021) ''[https://erepository.uonbi.ac.ke/handle/11295/155779 Mathematical Modelling of Hiv-aids Transmission Dynamics Coupled With Awareness Among Adolescents and Young Adults in Kenya].'' Doctoral dissertation, University of Nairobi.</ref> Kagunda has also participated in initiatives to explore the role of data-driven methodologies in pandemic modelling and control with students at specialist mathematics Cimpa Kenya School.<ref>{{Cite web |date=July 2015 |title=Escuela Cimpa Kenia |url=https://10times.com/es/e1h4-4h2s-3dgs-r |access-date=2025-08-05 |website=10times.com |language=Spanish}}</ref>

Kagunda is a member and the chair of the [[African Women in Mathematics Association]] (AWMA) and a member of the Kenya Women in Mathematical Sciences Association (KWIMSA).<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Citation |last=Ouedraogo |first=Marie Françoise |chapter=The African Women in Mathematics Association |date=2022 |title=Fifty Years of Women in Mathematics: Reminiscences, History, and Visions for the Future of AWM |pages=1051–1064 |editor-last=Beery |editor-first=Janet L. |chapter-url=https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-82658-1_89 |access-date=2025-07-15 |place=Cham |publisher=Springer International Publishing |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-030-82658-1_89 |isbn=978-3-030-82658-1 |editor2-last=Greenwald |editor2-first=Sarah J. |editor3-last=Kessel |editor3-first=Cathy|chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Beery |first=Janet L. |url=https://www.google.co.uk/books/edition/Fifty_Years_of_Women_in_Mathematics/bWBsEAAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=Josephine+Wairimu+Kagunda&pg=PA1063&printsec=frontcover |title=Fifty Years of Women in Mathematics: Reminiscences, History, and Visions for the Future of AWM |last2=Greenwald |first2=Sarah J. |last3=Kessel |first3=Cathy |date=2022-04-21 |publisher=Springer Nature |isbn=978-3-030-82658-1 |pages=1063 |language=en}}</ref> She is a reviewer for the international peer-reviewed journal the ''Universal Journal of Applied Mathematics''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Universal Journal of Applied Mathematics |url=http://www.hrpub.org/journals/jour_reviewers.php?id=26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200712154456/http://www.hrpub.org/journals/jour_reviewers.php?id=26 |archive-date=2020-07-12 |access-date=2025-07-18 |website=HRPUB}}</ref>

In 2023, Kagunda presented at the SciDataCon as part of International Data Week 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Poster Session {{!}} International Data Week |url=https://internationaldataweek.org/poster-session/ |access-date=2025-07-18 |language=en-US}}</ref> In January 2025, Kagunda presented at the [[American Mathematical Society]]'s Joint Mathematics Meetings AWM Special Session on modelling infectious disease dynamics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Joint Mathematics Meetings |url=https://jointmathematicsmeetings.org/meetings/national/jmm2025/2314_program_awmss1.html |access-date=2025-07-16 |website=Joint Mathematics Meetings |language=en |archive-date=14 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240914121900/https://jointmathematicsmeetings.org/meetings/national/jmm2025/2314_program_awmss1.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
